Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 11
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner introduced a flawed “fallback” rule to assign Maria of Aragon a Portuguese nationality based on her status as Queen of Portugal at the time of Ferdinand’s birth. Nationality should be determined by her origin/birth (she was an Aragonese/Spanish infanta, born in Córdoba), not by consort title. This incorrect inference overrode the correct direction (Spanish/Aragonese) already supported by sources and led toward a wrong solution.
